comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of the peptide shows 92.8% similarity to Ranatuerin-2PLa. GRAVY: 0.23; Mol Wt: 2920.502; Mol formula: C124H221N33O39S3. Structure: In 50% TFE, it is helical. Activity: Active against S. aureus NCTC 10788 (MIC 32 uM) and E. coli NCTC 10418 (MIC 32 uM). Inactive: C.albicans NCTC 1467 (MIC 256 uM), MRSA ATCC 12493 (MIC 256 uM) (MRSA-inactive), E.fecalis NCTC 12697 (MIC 128 uM), and P.aeruginosa ATCC 27853 (MIC >512 uM). MOA:cancer: This peptide also inhibits the proliferation of several tumour cells, such as prostate cancer cell, PC-3, probably via apoptosis. Updated Jan2020; 7/2021; 6/2025
